description:
Decision prerequisite for Replicated strategy, not authorization to guess. Confirm sender access to sent-message history and available authoritative recipients including BCC; neither From nor visible To/Cc implies unavailable delivery evidence. Define treatment of newly added recipients and outbound bot replies. Acceptance: explicit decision recorded with approved examples; no retroactive recipient access. Files to inspect: EmailBridge/IMAP parser/SMTP normalization and their tests. Tests to specify before implementation: To/Cc membership changes, hidden/missing recipient evidence, sender copy, reply-chain isolation. Action reuse: reuse transport normalization and new strategy contract. Mocking: email fixtures only. Documentation: Channels email strategy contract.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Human decision (2026-09-25): Replicated email creates a sender copy and treats visible To/Cc headers as authorized recipients, even though headers do not prove SMTP delivery. Hidden BCC is not inferred from visible headers: attach only if the address is independently known as the receiving mailbox or confirmed outbound envelope recipient. Scope is per message: a newly added To/Cc address sees that message and future addressed messages only, never earlier conversation history; replies and bot replies carry only their own sender + per-message recipient evidence. Existing parser currently extracts sender and threading, not full To/Cc/BCC lists; IMAP mailbox field is a folder name, not itself a recipient address; SMTP sender currently sends to one explicit identifier and returns :ok/error. Tests for sender copy, evolving To/Cc, hidden BCC/no authoritative mailbox, SMTP reply, no retroactive association belong to zaq-emb.14/.4. Reuse transport normalization and strategy; no parallel email ACL.

title: [zaq-emb.17] Confirm replicated-email sender and recipient evidence contract
